name: Throne of Hearts: Rise from the Nightmare
source: You live in a peaceful village in the outskirts of a magical kingdom. Your village is attacked by monsters and your parents don't make it. After all the devastation you are lucky to be adopted by royalty due to your latent magical potential and something that may have happened between you and Minori, a princess of the powerful and fiery Takeda clan. Take control of the story and experience the exciting characters and world building!
translation: 你住在一个魔法王国郊区的一个宁静的村庄里。你的村庄遭到怪物的袭击，而你的父母却未能幸免。在经历了所有的破坏之后，你很幸运地被皇室收养，因为你潜在的魔法潜力以及你和强大而火热的武田氏族的公主Minori之间可能发生的事情。掌控故事并体验激动人心的角色和世界建设！
